_comment: Single source of the shell's sizes, radii and timings (px at scale 1, ms).
Current values are PLACEHOLDERS taken from the GNOME layer (docs/fenestra-shell/INVENTORY.md §8).
design/reference/measurements.json (tests/visual/measure.py) replaces them key by key:
a key there with reliable=true wins over the value here (tools/apply-measurements.py).

_sources.desktop.label.gamma: label coverage a -> a^(1/1.15): Windows' ClearType labels (solid/dark-100-01, dark-150-01) vs the bench (tests/window-frames/desk_boxes.py): pixels > 200 at 150 % 240/161/309 vs Windows 236/160/308, summed ink +8 %; at 100 % ink -4 % (1.0: -7 %)

_sources.oem.samsung.osd.height: SamsungSystemSupportOSD.exe (Samsung System Support Service, DriverStore sfourswcomp15, May 2026), disassembled (objdump): OSDHandler lays out in 96-dpi px scaled by GetDpiForWindow/96: icon rect (14, 12)-(34, 32), text at x = 34 + 12 = 46 (14 without icon), y = 12, height max(DirectWrite height, 20), icon centred on it; window = text right + 14 by text bottom + 12 = 44; Segoe UI 14 (Malgun Gothic / Yu Gothic UI for ko / ja); centred on the work area, bottom edge 75 px above the work area's bottom (the taskbar's top); SetTimer 2400 ms, shown and hidden without animation
_sources.acrylic.samsung.dark: SamsungSystemSupportOSD.exe: SetWindowCompositionAttribute(WCA_ACCENT_POLICY, ACCENT_ENABLE_BLURBEHIND) + DwmSetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE, DWMWCP_ROUND = 8 px), then D2D Clear with the theme's background: dark #2C2C2C at 0.6, light #F9F9F9 at 0.8 (no border except in high contrast); text dark RGB(250, 250, 255), light RGB(1, 1, 2).
